rows: Saving a warning that is not before the time limit
Time and escalation come from fixed choices (Before / On Time / After the SLA time), so a warning after the limit cannot be set.
POST blueprint with warning 120 min and limit 120, warning 120 and limit 60, or a warning and no limit: all answer 201 Created and are saved as sent. The designer would block the same values.
A live blueprint with that state

The blueprint can be made active and tickets enter it. The ticket gets the due time but warning_due_at is null, so the warning actions never run. The designer shows the problem only when someone opens it.
